ideas.topic: The Secret Purpose of Egyptian Canopic Jars
ideas.hook: You’ve seen the masks, but have you ever wondered what exactly was kept inside those four mysterious jars?
ideas.why: It taps into the audience's morbid curiosity about mummification rituals, similar to the high-performing mummy decomposition video.

ideas.topic: The Real Daily Diet of a Pyramid Builder
ideas.hook: Forget the myths of slave labor; archaeology reveals the pyramid builders ate better than most of us do today.
ideas.why: It debunks popular misconceptions about the Pyramids while focusing on the relatable, human side of ancient life.

ideas.topic: Was Nefertiti the Most Powerful Woman You've Never Heard Of?
ideas.hook: She wasn't just a queen; recent evidence suggests she may have ruled Egypt as a sole Pharaoh.
ideas.why: It leverages the proven success of 'famous figure' historical profiles while offering a fresh, mysterious angle that invites debate.
